comments: We really enjoyed our stay here. It has everything you need for a short stay and the location is perfect.
Great spot to see the city. Laura was very helpful!
Forrest was a great host. The apartment is at a great location in Central within a few seconds walk to bars, restaurantsand markers and yet have outdoor space where you can relax.
Loved staying here. Beautiful flat once you are inside. Great location. Would stay here again.

I felt very comfortable and slept very well after my long working days in the wide bed. For my purposes as a single person, the apartment had everything I needed. Everything was exactly as described in the advert. Simple, no frills and luxury. But very authentic. However, the advert could have been briefly mentioned that the shower and toilet share a single room. I would still be happy to come back asap  Thank you for your hospitality.

Perfect spot if you are on business trip. Closest to all necessary spots in downtown. Check in, hospitality, communication - all were outstanding.
I’d recommend to ask at least 25+ floor while booking to make sure you will have same view as on the photos above (lower floors are facing buildings opposite).
Minor warnings: slowish WiFi not enough if you are YouTube blogger. But enough for basic things.
Stuff was extremely kind to keep my luggage after check out, because my flight was late and bags were heavy )
Recommend!
The studio is bright and airy and quiet. It has everything you need for a stay of a few days or even more. I would definitely stay again. Darren is very communicative.
Perfect location, amazing communication, a real gem in central Hong Kong. Couldn't ask for more
Great location，good service.
Great place with Yu. Convenient, clean, and quiet. Fair value. Would recommend.

We loved our stay at David’s! It’s a lovely flat with everything you need to feel right at home. Lots of things are walkable, the neighbours are friendly and David gave us some great cafe recommendations for coffee. I can only recommend staying here!
A convenient and centrally located apartment. Within easy reach of all the city hotspots and attractions. On my future trips I would definitely look to booking this studio.
Fantastic apartment in the heart of Soho. Well designed and everything is new. I enjoyed my stay and would definitely book again.

Had a great stay at Benjamin’s place. It was an extremely clean, modern apartment with a very comfortable bed. It was exactly as pictured and described. Great position close to MTR, trams and buses, so it was extremely easy to get around to all parts of Hong Kong and beyond. Benjamin was the perfect host, helpful, responsive and when we had a query nothing was too much trouble for him.
We highly recommend this apartment for a Hong Kong stay.
Irene & Gary Ashton

The flat was nice, clean, good located, just 5 min from the metro Central and about 10 min from the port (star ferry and Macau ferry). The Veronica (Brendan's mother) was very nice and hospitality. We recommended it for tourists who come in HK for a short period.
Ethan is a responsive and kind host recommend to stay in this apartment while travelling in Hong Kong

Laura's apartment was perfect for our stay un Hong Kong! It's in the perfect neighborhood and tucked away from the busy streets. The beds are so comfortable and the place is very well decorated and super clean.
Loved this cozy home and will definitely stay again in the future!!

Todor’s place is exactly as it’s shown in the pictures, location is hard to beat with soho within minutes walk and a really cool beer place downstairs. Rooftop also looks really nice, shame we only stayed for a day so didn’t have the chance to use it!
One tiny thing to note is that it’s located at the top of an old-fashioned Hong Kong style building, so you’ll have to walk quite a bit up the stairs to reach the flat, but the stairs are clean and bright so not much of a problem for me, walked up easily even when in heels 👌
非常不错
Nice Airbnb and the communication with Kevin was easy!

Located in a convenient and quiet area, this Airbnb was a disappointment during our ongoing 3-week trip across Asia, especially given our substantial luggage. The lack of essential amenities like internet and a blowdryer, along with very limited storage space, made managing our extensive luggage challenging. It appears more suitable for solo travelers, as it seems someone regularly lives there and only rents it out occasionally, which restricts space for guests' belongings. Despite its excellent location, the property is best suited for brief stays.

I had a great stay here, it was equipped with everything you might need and I appreciated the weekly cleaning/changing of towels etc. The space is clean, modern and as I stayed there while a cold front arrived, I was very grateful it had heating. Tane Residences were very communicative, and responded quickly to any questions I had. The check-in and check-out process was smooth and easy. The location is very convenient, situated around Poho but close enough to Sheung Wan and public transportation as well as cafes, restaurants and supermarkets.

Great location, nice space for a couple and an incredible view-we loved sitting out on the balcony and enjoying the view. Well designed modern bathroom. Easy to check in and communicate with Kay. Would definitely recommend staying here!

The location is great. The rooms are very small. They said the flat can  accommodate 7 but there are only 3 beds. We had difficulty in figuring out how to deal with the lock. Were unable to contact the landlord.
